title: 中文输入法下经常卡死
author: cxllxn

judgment.rationale: The report only says PowerToys frequently freezes while entering Chinese with WeChat Input Method on 0.94.0. It does not identify the active PowerToys module, exact trigger, affected process, recovery behavior, or diagnostic evidence.
evidence: The environment is Chinese Windows with WeChat Input Method and PowerToys 0.94.0.
The body has no expected/actual detail beyond frequent freezing.
The only reply is a second user indicating the same problem.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable reproduction with exact module, application, steps, and a post-hang report.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current evidence is too broad to identify which PowerToys process or feature hangs.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys reportedly freezes during Chinese text input with WeChat Input Method, but the affected module and trigger are unknown.
known_information: A second user reports the same symptom.
inferences: The hang may involve an input hook or a specific module, but the issue does not identify one.
issue_context.analysis: A fix assessment cannot be grounded without narrowing the process and reproduction boundary.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: The affected PowerToys module and application.
information_gaps.why_needed: Different modules use different input paths.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Disable modules to isolate the one required for the hang and name the foreground application.

information_gaps.information: A fresh report from current stable immediately after a hang.
information_gaps.why_needed: Logs are needed to identify the blocked process.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce once, recover if necessary, then submit /bugreport.

actions.label: Request focused Chinese IME hang evidence
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Please retest on the current stable PowerToys release and provide a focused reproduction: the foreground application, the exact WeChat Input Method version, which PowerToys modules must be enabled, the keystrokes immediately before the freeze, and how you recover. After one reproduction, please submit a comment containing `/bugreport` so the affected PowerToys process can be identified.
